chain.title: A Hinge and a Handle
chain.desc: A wooden chest and iron nuggets on a stick frame. The Cabinet Door is a crafting ingredient, not a block, and fourteen of the mod's thirty-five furniture types cannot be made without one - it is the single biggest gate in any Macaw's mod.

chain.title: The Other Half of the Gate
chain.desc: The same chest and nuggets in a shorter frame. Every drawer in the mod - single, double, triple, large, lower triple and both bookshelf drawers - takes one of these.

chain.title: Start Low
chain.desc: A log over a fence. The furniture graph starts here: coffee table into table, table into end table, end table into glass table - four steps, each one built from the last.

chain.title: Raise It
chain.desc: A coffee table over a fence. This is the only Macaw's mod where a decoration is crafted from another decoration of the same mod as a matter of course.

chain.title: And Again
chain.desc: A table over a log. The End Table is the third rung and the parent of the glass table.

chain.title: Glass on Top
chain.desc: An end table under a block of glass. Fourth and last rung of the table ladder.

chain.title: Somewhere to Sit
chain.desc: A fence, a log and two slabs. Chair, modern chair, striped chair and stool are four silhouettes on the same three ingredients.

chain.title: Storage in the Furniture
chain.desc: A cabinet drawer set in a ring of logs, four at a time. Drawers and cabinets have real inventories - the jar carries a 'Furniture Inventory' container title and open/close sounds for both.

chain.title: A Door on the Front
chain.desc: A cabinet door in a ring of logs, four at a time. Wardrobe, modern wardrobe and double wardrobe are three arrangements of the same two ingredients.

chain.title: The Kitchen Line
chain.desc: Cabinet door and logs in a two-wide frame. Kitchen cabinet, glass kitchen cabinet and double kitchen cabinet are the wall units.

chain.title: A Worktop
chain.desc: A slab over a log. Counters are the base unit, and the cupboard, drawer and double drawer counters are each a finished piece of furniture with a slab laid on it.

chain.title: Furniture Into Furniture
chain.desc: A wardrobe under a slab. The three counter upgrades are the clearest dependency in the mod: you must build the wardrobe or the drawer first, then top it.

chain.title: Plumbing
chain.desc: A cauldron and a water bucket over logs and slabs. The sink is the only recipe in the mod that consumes a bucket and the only one with a functional vanilla block in it.

chain.title: Something to Work At
chain.desc: Three logs over two fences. Desk, covered desk and modern desk are three silhouettes, and the modern one adds a stick.

chain.title: Books on the Wall
chain.desc: Books between rows of logs, four at a time. Adding a cabinet door gives the Cupboard Bookshelf and a cabinet drawer gives the two Bookshelf Drawers.

chain.title: Wool on a Frame
chain.desc: Three wool over two planks, four at a time. The chaise is the entry to the mod's sixteen-colour half.

chain.title: Add a Back
chain.desc: Wool over a chaise. Couch and chaise are sixteen colours each, and the couch is always downstream of the chaise of the same colour.

notes: MACAW'S MODS SHARE ONE STRUCTURE: A SMALL NUMBER OF DISTINCT BLOCK TYPES CROSSED WITH A LARGE MATERIAL TABLE. The chain below is one step per distinct RECIPE SHAPE, not one per id, and the material tables go to wheels. MODDB: no consensus signal - moddb.json contains no key for any Macaw's mod - so every ordering here is the recipe graph alone and there is no conflict to record. 654 IDS AND THE ONLY MACAW'S MOD WITH A GENUINE INTERNAL DEPENDENCY GRAPH. Verified against mcw-furniture-3.4.1-mc1.20.1forge.jar (Modrinth version 3.4.1, loaders=[forge], game_versions=[1.20.1]). ID DETECTION - PERFECTLY CLEAN: 654 item models, 652 blockstates, 654 lang block./item. keys, 654 recipes, 652 loot tables; models INTERSECT lang = 654, every one produced by a recipe. No stale lang keys, no orphan models, nothing to widen or narrow. STRUCTURE: 35 name-stems. Thirty-three of them are furniture types crossed with a 20-material wood table (the ten overworld woods, crimson and warped, and eight stripped-log variants), two are the sixteen-colour upholstery types (couch and chaise), and two are the crafting ingredients. 33 x 20 = 660 minus the gaps, plus 32 upholstery, plus 2 ingredients. WHY THIS ONE EARNS A LONGER CHAIN THAN ITS SIBLINGS: unlike Bridges, Roofs, Paths or Fences, this mod's recipes reference each other. mcwfurnitures:cabinet_door is an ingredient in fourteen furniture types (all three wardrobes, all three kitchen cabinets, the cupboard bookshelf and more) and mcwfurnitures:cabinet_drawer in seven (every drawer and both bookshelf drawers) - so both are hard prerequisites for roughly half the mod. On top of that there are four genuine crafting ladders: coffee_table -> table -> end_table -> glass_table; wardrobe -> cupboard_counter; drawer -> drawer_counter and double_drawer -> double_drawer_counter; chaise -> couch. That is a real graph, not a flat material table, and it is what the chain above traces. DISTINCT RECIPE SHAPES: 35 by pattern but about 20 that are structurally distinct once the cabinet-door and cabinet-drawer families are collapsed. Verified yields: cabinet_door 1, cabinet_drawer 1, coffee_table 1, table 1, end_table 1, glass_table 1, chair 1, modern_chair 1, striped_chair 1, stool_chair 1, counter 1, cupboard_counter 1, drawer_counter 1, kitchen_sink 1, desk 2, covered_desk 2, modern_desk 2, bookshelf 4, bookshelf_cupboard 4, bookshelf_drawer 4, drawer 4, double_drawer 4, triple_drawer 4, large_drawer 4, lower_triple_drawer 4, wardrobe 4, modern_wardrobe 4, double_wardrobe 4, kitchen_cabinet 4, glass_kitchen_cabinet 4, double_kitchen_cabinet 4, chaise 4, couch 1. MECHANICS: the jar carries mcwfurnitures.container.threerows = 'Furniture Inventory' plus cabinet_open, cabinet_close, drawer_open and drawer_close subtitles, so the drawers and cabinets are working three-row containers, not props. mcwfurnitures.furnitureitem.desc = 'Crafting Ingredient' is the tooltip on the cabinet door and drawer. NOTE ON THE MATERIAL TABLE: it is 20 wide, not 11, because eight stripped logs are first-class materials here (stripped_oak_kitchen_sink and friends all exist). A generator sizing wheels from a wood list alone will under-count this mod by nearly half. DROPS: none.
